reader.requirement: At 1985, FUNCTION VARIANCE must return zero when the argument series is one value, or when every argument is a variable-occurrence data item (table(ALL) under OCCURS DEPENDING ON) and their occurrences total one.

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 edition window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 Intrinsic Function module rows) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel; COBOL1502/1503 outside it

construct numeric-function-identifier-operand-2002: at 85 a numeric function written where an identifier stands (DISPLAY/MOVE operand) is refused (COBOL0900), per 1985 IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; 2002+ accepts it. Not consulted inside COMPUTE

DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: at 85 a COMPUTE with no SIZE ERROR phrase catches every size condition and continues (1985 VI.6.4.2 GR3); 2002+ takes the fatal-EC shape. Statement-level, around the function value, not inside it
num.StandardDecimal (arithmetic mode): the ARITHMETIC clause does not exist at 85, so 85 always takes the native arms, the same arms the latest edition takes by default

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicRenderer.cs and the runtime CobolIntrinsics.*.cs for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior: the renderer's function dispatch and every runtime body consult no edition (the runtime Intrinsics folder has none); the generated C# at --std 85 and --std 2023 differs only in the assembly Edition attribute and the COMPUTE size-error wrapper (diff of var85-002/var85.g.cs vs var85-003, trig85-001 vs trig85-002)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover only VARIANCE(5); the variable-occurrence arm (an ODO extent of one) is not exercised

probes.printed: VODO1= 00000.0000000000 (E(ALL) with N=1, E(1)=42.5); VODO11= 00000.0000000000 (E(ALL) E(ALL) with N=1: two equal values)
VZERO VARIANCE(0 0 0)= 0; VARIANCE of the 18-digit maximum twice (VBIGSAME) = 0
COBOL1504 FUNCTION VARIANCE takes at least 1 argument(s); 0 given

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.45.4 RV3  (cite.py --check with quoted words: "the returned value is zero")
OK  §1989:A.2.2 AR4  (cite.py --check with quoted words: "the range of values is determined by the object of the OCCURS DEPENDING ON clause")

reader.notes: TryVariance shifts every argument by the first, so a single value gives a numerator of exactly 0 and the narrowed result is exactly 0; the ODO extent is read at run time by CobolTable.AllArgs through OdoExtent. The emitted code is the same at 2023.

refuter.evidence: §1989:A.2.45.4 RV3 read whole: zero for one value, or all variable-occurrence items totalling one occurrence. varx-003: VARIANCE(E(ALL)) with ODO N=1 gives 0; with two ODO tables at N=1, M=1 (total two occurrences) it correctly gives 10.5625, not zero; a zero-occurrence ALL is undefined per A.2.2 last paragraph, not probed as a value. fnnames-001 and reader's VODO1/VZERO agree. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.45.4 RV3 ('the returned value is zero'); OK §1989:A.2.2 AR4 ('the range of values is determined by the object of the OCCURS DEPENDING ON clause').
